citations.claim: EW approaches show yellow at step 106 (start of yellow)
EW approaches still yellow at step 107 (second second of yellow)
first violating step: EW approaches already red at step 108, so yellow lasted only 2s instead of required 4s

counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (fixed-time cycle) keeping all other fields identical; this disables the long-wait recall that preempts the EW yellow early, so yellow runs its full 4s.

explanation: With actuated=true and NS approaches waiting 60+s queued (N queue 14 wait 60 at step 104), the controller's long-wait recall preempts the EW phase: EW green ends at step 106 into yellow, but after only 2s (steps 106-107) it is forced to all-red before NS at step 108, truncating yellow from required 4s to 2s. Fixed-time with same timings does not violate, confirming recall preemption cuts yellow short.
vision_note: In step 105 the EW approaches show green, then they switch to yellow for steps 106 and 107. By step 108 all approaches are red, so the yellow is visibly cut to only two seconds while a long queue still waits on the north approach.
